verdict.rationale: Bruno offers a documented CLI (bru) for running collections, generating reports, and CI/CD integration, and collections are stored as plain-text files that can be scripted/driven by agents (AGENTS.md, Codex/Cursor integration). However, there is no true public HTTP/REST API with an OpenAPI spec (probe confirms openapi.json 404s), so 'driving the product' is limited to CLI/file-based automation rather than a formal API. missing for 10: a documented HTTP/REST or SDK-based public API, OpenAPI/schema spec, independent verification of programmatic control beyond CLI.
